mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering corporate earnings weakness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for joint signal falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals manufacturing slowdown, increasing recession risk and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent price pressures, prompting aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing starts (HOUST above 1100.0) indicate robust consumer spending, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1100.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Weak job growth (PAYEMS monthly change < 50) indicates slowing labor market, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS monthly change < 50, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production (INDPRO > 110) signals strong manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 110, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
